ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with high-intensity (white) zones localized at distal extremities; approximate pixel frequency ratio of 85:15.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity (white) geometric blob located on the distal 1/5th of the right lobe; smaller, fragmented high-intensity patches on the distal left lobe tip; primary fluke body is characterized by low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 80 to 90 degrees; bounding-box depth is approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary displays low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations along the distal thirds of both lobes; the far left trailing edge exhibits a localized, high-amplitude jagged irregularity.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a distinct upward-sloping convex curve trajectory from the notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single distinct circular anomaly (dark interior ring on white background) located within the high-intensity zone of the distal right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Densely packed cluster of multi-directional, high-contrast (white) linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the central-distal region of the right lobe; sparse distribution on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring across the right lobe; circular puncture-type scar on the right tip; ragged/irregular trailing edge on the far left lobe extremity.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-density scar pattern on the medial-right lobe area.
